header: Training for your staff, in your own week
bodytext:
Half of what Bildungsforum Marnau teaches is booked by companies rather than by individuals: a bookkeeping refresher for two people in the accounts office, German for a kitchen brigade, the annual first-aid hours for everyone on the shop floor.

Company courses run at your address or in one of our four houses, in the mornings if that suits the shift better. One invoice, one contact, and the attendance list arrives the day the course ends.
